==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Qiuyan:''' Check the order and the goods, and be careful with the quantity. Make sure you transfer the goods correctly, as sending the wrong goods can damage our reputation.
:'''Qiuyan:''' This is a catchy rhyme I wrote myself. What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} That's a straightforward interpretation.
:'''Qiuyan:''' Hehe, thank you. I didn't get much of an education, but I enjoy reading and poetry in my spare time.
:'''Qiuyan:''' Lately, I've been brainstorming some more serious pieces.
:'''Qiuyan:''' What do you think about using the Whining Aix as inspiration?
:'''Qiuyan:''' Perhaps their mournful song isn't meant to intimidate humans, but merely a call between mates.
:{{DIcon}} That's an interesting interpretation.
:'''Qiuyan:''' The Whining Aix leaves the branch to soar. Unable to fly, they perish together...
{{Dialogue End}}
